training.candidate_selection: validation only; lowest joint normalized RMS/maximum error
training.loss: dimensionless defect-normalized mean-square plus squared maximum error
training.non_neural_fit: training-only ridge least-squares initialization followed by bounded matched RMS-plus-peak objective; validation selects initialization
training.stopping: bounded updates and per-unit walltime; retain selected initialization

scaling.case_order: descending batch size, then ascending grid, then target track; omitted cells remain NA

policies.selection: fixed family; seed and largest training subset fixed before confirmation
policies.reason: No new learned deployment policy until an independently measured solver-cost margin exists

scoring.score_meaning: required-check evidence attainment, not model quality

frontier: reference-informed fixed-time post-hoc schedule selection; not a deployable policy

claims.representation: retained signed nonlinear interactions before projection
claims.learning: improvement beyond matched normalized analytic and non-neural fitted controls
claims.neural: credible locally adapted FNO on equal data and measured compute, not a paper reproduction
claims.generalization: paired new fields/physics/grids/horizons within declared scope
claims.solver: complete accuracy-qualified cost with identical schedule opportunities
claims.numerical: a distilled analytic rule may be a successful result without neural inference

portfolio_budget.scope: discretionary training and exploratory prototypes only; shared audit/reference/confirmation separately bounded
portfolio_budget.reallocation: requires an explicitly recorded new development protocol; no automatic transfer

hypothesis_thresholds.comparison_unit: independent field; schedules/grids/seeds paired within field
hypothesis_thresholds.multiple_comparisons: declared primary tests; exploratory subgroup estimates unadjusted and labeled
hypothesis_thresholds.benefit_requires: declared effect threshold and field-cluster interval lower bound above one; coverage noninferiority checked separately

exploration.novelty: new to this project; no publication-priority claim

selection.selection_metric: joint RMS and maximum error with reference uncertainty; measured validation cost
